name: access_gantry
prompt: A rocket access gantry tower: a slim steel lattice tower with a long horizontal walkway arm at the top ending in a small white platform with railings, a staircase zigzagging up the side, red and white painted steel.

name: launch_pad_base
prompt: A wide round concrete rocket launch pad: a thick grey circular platform with a dark flame trench opening in the middle, yellow and black hazard stripes around the edge, small steel support beams under it.

name: safety_fence
prompt: A short section of white safety railing fence: three horizontal white bars between square posts with red reflectors, four posts in a straight row.

name: alien_mountain
prompt: A big alien mountain: one huge purple and pink rocky mountain with a jagged peak, layered rock stripes, glowing blue streaks on its slopes, wide base.

name: alien_mushroom
prompt: A cluster of three glowing alien mushrooms: tall thin stems with big round blue and teal glowing caps with small spots, growing from a little mound of dark rock.

name: alien_flower
prompt: A tall alien flower: a slim curved green stem with one large glowing pink and orange trumpet-shaped bloom on top and two big leaves near the bottom.

name: purple_boulder
prompt: A big round rough alien boulder: purple-grey rock with a flat bottom, cracks, and a few small blue crystal specks on top.

name: space_wrench
prompt: A big chunky cartoon spanner wrench: silver steel, open jaw at one end, round hole at the other end, orange rubber grip in the middle.

name: checklist_clipboard
prompt: A clipboard with a mission checklist: brown board, metal clip at the top, white paper with rows of small checkboxes and lines of text, a pencil attached by a string.

name: supply_crate
prompt: A rugged orange supply crate: a box with metal corners, a handle on each side, a white label and a black stripe, rounded edges.

name: fuel_tank
prompt: A tall white cylindrical rocket fuel tank standing upright on three steel legs, with a red warning band, a ladder on the side, and a pipe running out of the bottom.

name: alien_tree
prompt: A strange alien tree: a thick twisted violet trunk splitting into three curved branches, each ending in a big round glowing teal leaf-ball, small pink glowing berries.
